title: Nonzero stalks of a simple lisse Weil sheaf respect a clopen partition
statement: Let k be a finite field, l an invertible prime, X a k-scheme locally of finite type, and V an irreducible lisse Weil sheaf [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex, def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves]. For any clopen open subscheme U of X and finite points x,y with nonzero V-stalks, x in U implies y in U. No smoothness, affineness, geometric irreducibility, or change of constants is required.

source.place: Paragraphs 1--3 and 7: geometric constituents, two-point curve restriction and local Frobenius powers; geometric socle/Frobenius orbit step in sk-i-dl-general-real.

proof.text: Let W be the complementary clopen open. Both immersions are finite etale. Restrict V to U and push forward to G. G is lisse by the source-library theorem IsLisse.lowerStar_of_finite_etale. The kernel K of the adjunction unit V to G is lisse by IsLisse.kernel_cokernel. These operations are in the native Weil category and preserve its Frobenius structure.

source.place: Paragraphs 1--3 and 7: geometric constituents, two-point curve restriction and local Frobenius powers; geometric socle/Frobenius orbit step in sk-i-dl-general-real.

proof.text: Apply arithmetic irreducibility to the monomorphism K to V. If K is zero, the unit is mono. Restriction to W preserves monomorphisms, while restriction of G to W is zero by the disjoint-support theorem. Thus V restricts to zero on W, contradicting the nonzero stalk at y if y lies there.

source.place: Paragraphs 1--3 and 7: geometric constituents, two-point curve restriction and local Frobenius powers; geometric socle/Frobenius orbit step in sk-i-dl-general-real.

proof.text: If K to V is an isomorphism, the kernel equation forces the unit to be zero. The adjunction triangle identity then makes the identity of the restriction of V to U zero. Stalk restriction identifies its stalk at x with the nonzero stalk of V, a contradiction. For U empty the premise is impossible; for U full there is nothing to prove.

lean.statement:
theorem IsIrreducibleLisse.mem_clopen_of_nontrivial_stalk
    {k₀ : Type u} [Field k₀] [Finite k₀] {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime]
    [Fact (ringChar k₀ ≠ l)] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    (V : WeilSheaf k₀ l X) (hV : V.IsIrreducibleLisse)
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsClopen (U : Set X))
    (x y : X.finitePoints) (hxU : x.1 ∈ U)
    (hx : Nontrivial (V.stalk x).carrier) (hy : Nontrivial (V.stalk y).carrier) :
    y.1 ∈ U
